recommendedSlice.name: Phase-aware display-only progression guides
whySmallestSafestUseful: Closes the largest remaining functional gap after MAP-2B: disconnected markers with no progression geometry.
Reuses the exact same trusted points ActiveRideMapCameraPolicy already frames — no new data plane.
Zero backend / RTDB / publisher / Google Routes / MAP-1 / MAP-2A / MAP-2B camera-policy changes.
Does NOT claim to be a road route or ETA — explicit guide semantics avoid inventing navigation authority.
Isolatable pure policy + ActiveRideMap polylines; unit/widget tests; physical proof mirrors MAP-2B order (passenger open before publish).
Leaves C2/C3/D as documented later slices when a real route/ETA authority is designed.
exactInScope: Add a pure progression policy (e.g. ActiveRideMapProgressionPolicy) keyed by camera phase: to_pickup → segment(s) among driver (when shown)+pickup (+optional faint pickup→dest context); to_dest → driver+destination (+optional faint pickup→dest); no-driver → optional pickup→dest guide only
Render GoogleMap polylines from those LatLng endpoints only — dashed/distinct stroke; never from client-invented road geometry or estimate polylines
Update guide endpoints when driver marker position updates — WITHOUT calling animateCamera / without changing MAP-2B fitIdentity rules
Accessibility semantics that distinguish guide lines from road routes (content-desc / semantics label)
Soft-fail: missing points → omit polyline; never gate cancel/close; never throw
Unit tests for phase segment selection; widget test that RTDB seq ticks update polyline endpoints but do not spam animateCamera

Physical proof: waiting→first fix shows driver↔pickup guide; multi-publish keeps guide without camera thrash; RIDE_STARTED switches toward destination guide; terminal safe; MAP-2A cleanup + MAP-1 smoke
exactOutOfScope: Road/encoded polylines from Google Routes on active ride (Candidate C2/C3)
Persisting or exposing RideDoc.routePolyline on publicRide
Reusing MAP-1 / pricing estimate encodedPolyline as live active-ride geometry
Client straight-line-as-road marketing or turning guides into 'navigation'
ETA of any kind (server or client); speed×distance; pricing durationMin as arrival time
Marker interpolation / cinematic camera / tilt / 3D / custom markers / map styling
Changes to ActiveRideMapCameraPolicy fitIdentity / thrash guarantees (MAP-2B frozen)
TripLocationSession / RTDB schema/rules / driver publisher / POST /v1/location/update
MAP-1 RideMapPreview / request flow behavior changes
Mapbox / custom tiles / glow / shadows / route animation

stateLifecycleBehavior.DRIVER_ASSIGNED_beforeFix: No driver endpoint → optional pickup↔dest guide only OR no guide; waiting banner unchanged
stateLifecycleBehavior.DRIVER_ASSIGNED_afterFix: to_pickup guide driver↔pickup appears with marker; camera may reframe once per MAP-2B
stateLifecycleBehavior.DRIVER_EN_ROUTE: Same to_pickup guide; endpoints track driver ticks; camera stable
stateLifecycleBehavior.DRIVER_ARRIVED: Same to_pickup; short segment near pickup expected
stateLifecycleBehavior.RIDE_STARTED: Switch to to_dest guide driver↔destination; one camera phase reframe (MAP-2B); no continuous follow
stateLifecycleBehavior.expired_missing_driver: Drop driver endpoint; fall back to anchors-only guide or none — never keep phantom endpoint
stateLifecycleBehavior.terminal: Unmount/stop listen per MAP-2A; polylines gone with map; no new cleanup path
stateLifecycleBehavior.backgroundForeground: No extra work beyond MAP-2A resume; do not force camera thrash

failureBehavior.rtdbUnavailable: anchors-only optional guide; MAP-2A banner unchanged

physicalProofPlan.orderCritical: Passenger Active Ride MUST be open and listening BEFORE first fresh publish (MAP-2B lesson)
steps: Open passenger Active Ride — assert map + pickup + dest; waiting/no driver marker; optional anchors guide only
Keep FG — publish fresh assigned-driver location (L2 or POST /v1/location/update contract)
Assert driver marker + driver↔pickup guide appears; one intentional camera reframe (MAP-2B)
≥2–3 more publishes — guide endpoints move; camera does not thrash
EN_ROUTE / ARRIVED — to_pickup guide remains; stable camera
RIDE_STARTED — guide favors destination; one phase camera reframe; map functional
Cancel — no crash; RTDB/ACL cleanup; MAP-1 smoke short
physicalProofPlan.greenRule: GREEN only if phase-aware guides proven on-device without inventing road/ETA authority; do not claim visual-design GREEN
